clue.text: Dismal churl's plea out of order

indicators.note: something out of order is jumbled up, so the letters before it must be rearranged

blocks.note: the letters of both words, apostrophe ignored

explanation.surface: A boorish man's appeal to the court is a jumbled, gloomy affair.
explanation.definitionFit: Sepulchral means tomb-like, hence gloomy and mournful in tone or atmosphere.

clue.text: Excerpt from classic known poorly

indicators.note: an excerpt is a passage taken from within, so the letters lie inside the next words

blocks.note: the run straddling the two words

explanation.surface: A quotation from a celebrated work that is little known.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Poorly' reads as an adverb modifying known, but it is the British adjective for unwell.
explanation.definitionFit: In British usage, feeling poorly means unwell or ill, the same as sick.

clue.text: Write meal menus, including price for church members

indicators.note: including takes something inside, so the meal menus enclose the price

blocks.note: to pen is to write
tea is a meal, and menus are lists
cost is the price

explanation.surface: Instructions to print a priced menu for a church supper.
explanation.walkthrough: Tea is a meal in Britain, often the evening one.
explanation.definitionFit: Pentecostalists belong to evangelical churches stressing gifts of the Holy Spirit such as speaking in tongues.

clue.text: Viewing river going north in Cornish town

indicators.note: in a down clue going north means upward, so the river is read backwards
in puts the river inside the name of the town

blocks.note: the Esk is one of several British rivers of that name
Looe is a fishing town in Cornwall, south-west England

explanation.surface: A sightseer watching a river flow northwards through a Cornish harbour town.
explanation.definitionFit: A look-see is an informal quick look or inspection, a viewing of something.

clue.text: Part of Bible taken in by man and left in place for guests?

indicators.note: taken in by means held inside, so the man word wraps the Bible part

blocks.note: he is the male pronoun
OT is the Old Testament
L is the abbreviation for left

explanation.surface: A Bible left in a hotel room by the Gideons for guests.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark nods to the Gideon Bibles placed in hotel rooms.
explanation.definitionFit: A hotel is an establishment providing lodging and meals for paying guests.

clue.text: Name received by experts on search yielding weight of family history

indicators.note: received by means taken in, so the experts hold the name abbreviation
yielding means giving up, so the search word surrenders the letter for weight

blocks.note: aces are experts or champions
N abbreviates name
to trawl is to search thoroughly
W abbreviates weight; this letter is removed

explanation.surface: A name found by genealogists yields clues to one's lineage.
explanation.definitionFit: Ancestral describes what belongs to or comes from one's forebears, the line of family descent.

clue.text: Fancy missing hour after second reel

indicators.note: a thing missing something lacks it, so one letter is dropped from the word for fancy

blocks.note: S is the standard abbreviation for second
a whim is a passing fancy
H abbreviates hour; this is the letter removed

explanation.surface: An angler fancies an hour off after a second cast of the reel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After second' places the reduced fancy behind the S. 'Reel' is a verb here, as when one's head swims.
explanation.definitionFit: When your head swims you feel giddy and unsteady, which is to reel.

clue.text: Song on life will have moving, overwhelming emotion finally

indicators.note: moving means shifting position, so the letters are set in motion into a new order
finally points to the last letter of the word just before it

blocks.note: all the letters of these four words
the last letter of emotion

explanation.surface: A love song on how strong feeling overwhelms a life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Moving' and 'overwhelming emotion' suggest the song's mood, but the first is the anagram signal. It is a jazz standard recorded by Nat King Cole.
explanation.definitionFit: When I Fall in Love is a 1952 ballad, a well-known popular song.

clue.text: Not loudly, signify most cranky person averse to women

indicators.note: loudly in music is forte, abbreviated F, and not means that letter is dropped
cranky means eccentric or out of kilter, so the letters are put in a twisted order

blocks.note: the letters of both words

explanation.surface: Without shouting, show what the grumpiest woman-hater means.
explanation.walkthrough: F (forte, loud) is removed from the letters before they are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A misogynist is someone who dislikes, distrusts or is prejudiced against women.

clue.text: Hurt, not on purpose

blocks.note: off is the opposite of on
an end is an aim or purpose

explanation.surface: Someone apologises: the hurt was accidental, not deliberate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not on purpose' looks like a single phrase meaning accidentally; split it after on.
explanation.definitionFit: To offend someone is to hurt their feelings or upset them.

clue.text: Deceive kind partner

blocks.note: to con is to trick or deceive
a sort is a kind or type

explanation.surface: A warning about a seemingly gentle spouse who is really a cheat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Kind' looks like an adjective describing the partner, but it is the noun meaning type.
explanation.definitionFit: A consort is a spouse or companion, especially of a reigning monarch.

clue.text: Funds from hundred volunteers

blocks.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
a verb: to volunteer is to offer

explanation.surface: A charity's money comes from a hundred helpers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Volunteers' reads as a noun (helpers) but is the verb, as in someone volunteers or offers.
explanation.definitionFit: Coffers are strongboxes, and by extension the financial reserves or funds of an organisation.

clue.text: Undemanding music, say, is in gentle broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast also means scattered widely, as seed is, so the letters are strewn into a new order

blocks.note: all the letters of these four words

explanation.surface: Light background music, so to speak, is what a soft radio broadcast offers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Say' looks like a link meaning 'for example', but its letters are part of the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Easy listening is the genre name for mellow, unchallenging popular and orchestral music.

clue.text: Sea creature well below wave in south-west

indicators.note: in places the wave word inside the abbreviation for south-west
in a down clue below means placed underneath, so the word for well comes last

blocks.note: SW abbreviates south-west
a perm is a hair wave
hale means healthy, well

explanation.surface: A sea animal swimming deep under the waves off the south-west coast.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'below' puts the word for well after the rest. A perm is a permanent wave in hair.
explanation.definitionFit: The sperm whale is a large toothed whale, a marine animal.

clue.text: Academic posers for unravelling

indicators.note: something unravelling comes apart and gets tangled, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: the letters of both words

explanation.surface: A scholar sets puzzles for students to work out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For' looks like a link word but its letters are needed in the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: A professor is a senior university teacher, an academic of the highest rank.

clue.text: Whose epic developed into outstanding example?

indicators.note: developed into means grown into a new form, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: the letters of both words

explanation.surface: Asking whose grand saga became a masterpiece.
explanation.definitionFit: A showpiece is a fine specimen displayed as a model of its kind.

clue.text: Empty clamour surrounding artist

indicators.note: surrounding means going all round, so the word for clamour wraps the artist

blocks.note: a din is a loud clamour
RA is a Royal Academician, the crossword's usual artist

explanation.surface: Hollow noise is all that surrounds a painter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Empty' looks like an adjective, but it is the verb, to empty out.
explanation.definitionFit: To drain a vessel is to let all its liquid run out, so to empty it.

clue.text: Blushing about thanks, in retirement, deserved

indicators.note: retiring means drawing back, so the word for thanks is read backwards
about here means around, so the blushing colour goes round the other piece

blocks.note: a blushing face is red
ta is informal British for thank you

explanation.surface: Someone blushing at a farewell thank-you on retiring felt it was earned.
explanation.definitionFit: If something rated a mention it merited or warranted one, so it deserved it.

clue.text: Drawing line in poem supporting party

indicators.note: in puts the line abbreviation inside the word for poem
in a down clue supporting means sitting underneath, so this piece follows the party

blocks.note: a do is a party
an ode is a lyric poem
L abbreviates line

explanation.surface: Sketching a line of verse to back a political party.
explanation.definitionFit: A doodle is an idle, aimless drawing or scribble.

clue.text: Old life is transformed in areas yielding fuel

indicators.note: transformed means changed in shape, so the letters take a new form

blocks.note: all the letters of these three words

explanation.surface: Ancient life, crushed and changed over ages, becomes the source of petroleum.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface is apt: crude oil really is ancient organisms transformed.
explanation.definitionFit: Oilfields are regions with underground petroleum deposits that are drilled for fuel.

clue.text: Restriction in furniture seller's floral art

indicators.note: in puts the restriction inside the store's name

blocks.note: IKEA is the Swedish flat-pack furniture chain
a ban is a restriction

explanation.surface: A store's rule bans the flower arrangements on display.
explanation.walkthrough: The possessive 's is just surface glue.
explanation.definitionFit: Ikebana is the Japanese art of arranging flowers.

clue.text: Sales talk in particular behind desire for ceramic design

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other, so the sales talk goes within the word for particular
behind means coming after, so this part is written following the word for desire

blocks.note: will as in wish or desire
one's own is particular to oneself
patter is a salesman's glib spiel

explanation.surface: A salesman's pitch is fuelled by a craving to sell decorative china.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Behind desire' puts the contained piece after the word for desire.
explanation.definitionFit: Willow pattern is the classic blue-and-white Chinese-style decoration on English porcelain plates.

clue.text: Bone identified by one cutting a fragment up

indicators.note: in a down clue up means reading from the bottom, so the fragment phrase runs backwards
cutting means slicing into, so the numeral goes inside

blocks.note: a bit is a fragment
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A forensic scientist identifies a bone by cutting off a sliver.
explanation.definitionFit: The tibia is the shinbone, the larger of the two lower-leg bones.

clue.text: Wait for prop

blocks.note: first meaning: remain, hang on
second meaning: a support or brace

explanation.walkthrough: 'Wait for' reads as a phrasal verb, but 'for' only links the two meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: To stay is to remain or wait; a stay is also a supporting rope or brace.

clue.text: Clear sailor with volume in fish

indicators.note: in puts the volume abbreviation inside the word for the fish

blocks.note: AB is an able-bodied seaman
the sole is a flatfish
V is an abbreviation for volume

explanation.surface: A seaman with a great quantity of fish is let off.
explanation.definitionFit: To absolve is to clear of guilt or blame, to declare free from charges.

clue.text: Confirm contest to grab attention

indicators.note: grabbing something holds it, so the contest word clasps the attention word

blocks.note: a bout is a boxing match or contest
to have someone's ear is their attention

explanation.surface: Someone confirms a competition designed to attract notice.
explanation.definitionFit: To bear out a claim is to support or corroborate it, a phrasal verb meaning verify.

clue.text: Back in classes learning more

indicators.note: in says the letters lie inside the run of words that follows
back means going in the opposite direction, so the run is read right to left

blocks.note: the run straddling the end of one word and the start of the next

explanation.surface: Returning to lessons means more studying.
explanation.walkthrough: The run is the end of classes and the start of learning, read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Else means other or additional, as in 'anything else?', so it stands for more.

clue.text: Soldier enters inflexible city alone

indicators.note: entering goes inside, so the soldier is placed within the word for inflexible

blocks.note: set as in fixed, set in one's ways
a para is a paratrooper
Ely is a small cathedral city in Cambridgeshire

explanation.surface: A soldier marches into a rigid, unwelcoming city on his own.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing things separately means individually, apart from others, which is alone.
